verdict.rationale: Viam's Registry explicitly provides pre-built drivers/modules for common hardware (cameras, motors, arms) so developers don't need to implement their own, and docs describe searching the registry by manufacturer/hardware type and pulling models automatically into config. This is corroborated by pricing page listing 'Modular Components: Pre-built modules or build your own' and the modules overview describing how registry-sourced or custom modules behave like built-in components. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of registry browsing experience or breadth/quality of available modules beyond first-party docs.
